summary: R122-based German source-audit webdrop built on the P16 sourcefix branch. It preserves the P16 alpha-coefficient fix and adds two targeted source-certain Paper 13 corrections on printed pp.237-238.
verification_summary: Base is Noether_R122_P16_SourceAudit_WebDrop_20260624, preserving the earlier P16 alpha-coefficient fix.
P13 p235-p236 are recorded as checked-no-new-patch for selected title/source apparatus survival checks.
P13 p237 fixes the suppressed-index example from u_nu/(x_i,x_k) to source u_alpha/(x_beta,x_gamma).
P13 p238 fixes nonsensical Herrn to source Heun before the Lagrange central equation reference.
The package explicitly leaves P13 pp.239-257 unchecked in this drop.
limitations: Candidate review package only; not a promoted canonical branch unless later accepted/reconciled.
Targeted P13 micro-pass over source pp.235-238 plus survival checks; not a full P13 page-by-page certification.
The P13 GDZ image metadata is mostly 400 PPI, below the ideal 650+ threshold; enlarged 1000 dpi crops improve readability but do not add native source detail.
No English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, or Interslavic synchronization is included.
Not a critical edition, not whole-corpus certification, and not final Noether closure.
recommended_next_action: Review/reconcile the two P13 corrections into the current German branch if accepted, then continue Paper 13 source audit from p239 onward before multilingual propagation.
github_note: Corrections and source comparisons can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
